assessments.reasoning: Under the creation method’s assertions, the fresh local name becomes an initialized, immutable binding that records a target module and name. The read method retrieves that module’s environment and delegates the read of the recorded name to it. Immutability applies to the local binding. Each successful read obtains the target’s current value.

challenge.method: Trace reads after a target value changes, before its environment exists, and while its direct binding is uninitialized.
challenge.results: Delegation observes the current target value. An absent environment raises ReferenceError at the importing side. An uninitialized direct target raises ReferenceError in the delegated read, whose abrupt result propagates even though the local binding is initialized.

limitations: Indirection does not make the target value immutable. A target environment that is not instantiated or a target binding that is uninitialized can still cause ReferenceError.
Only the exact Module Environment Record methods are in scope. Runtime observation of a pair of modules does not independently prove every graph or host behavior.
